description: Quarks Digital helps businesses grow through SEO, social media marketing, web and app development, brand strategy, and business automation.
positioning: One team designs the interface, writes the code, tunes the search rankings, automates the back office and runs the channels. No handoffs between four vendors.

services.name: UI/UX design
services.summary: Research, wireframes and a design system your developers can actually build from - not a picture that falls apart in code.

services.name: Web development
services.summary: Next.js sites that load fast, rank out of the box, and can be edited by someone who has never seen a terminal.

services.name: App development
services.summary: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps, from the first screen to the store listing and the crash dashboard after launch.

services.name: 3D & interactive
services.summary: WebGL scenes, scroll-driven film and product configurators - the reason people stay on the page instead of bouncing.

services.name: SEO
services.summary: Technical repairs, content architecture and digital PR aimed at the top results - reported as traffic and revenue, not vanity keywords.

services.name: ASO
services.summary: Store listings, creative sets and keyword coverage tuned until an install costs less than it did last month.

services.name: Performance & CRO
services.summary: We find the exact steps where money leaks out of your funnel, then close them one experiment at a time.

services.name: Business automation
services.summary: The spreadsheet work your team repeats every week, handed to software: lead routing, CRM sync, invoicing, reporting.

services.name: Social media marketing
services.summary: Channel strategy plus daily execution and community management - a team that posts, replies and reads the analytics.

services.name: Content production
services.summary: Photo, video and 3D shot in one production block, cut into feed-ready assets you own outright.

target_audience: Local businesses in Odisha and across India
verified_facts: One team covers design, engineering, SEO, automation and social media
voice_notes: Short declarative sentences. Concrete over clever. Speaks like the people doing the work, not an account manager. Never hypes.
default_cta: DM us to talk through your project
banned_phrases: take it to the next level
